mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_cluster_reclassification_run WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_cluster_reclassification_run ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM t_cluster_reclassification_run WHERE run_status IN ('REQUESTED','RUNNING','FINALIZING','ROLLING_BACK') AND id <> #{excludeId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_cluster_reclassification_run(public_id, request_id, run_status, reason, requested_by, snapshot_safe_count, started_at) VALUES(#{row.publicId}, #{row.requestId}, 'RUNNING', #{row.reason}, #{row.requestedBy}, #{row.snapshotSafeCount}, NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_cluster_reclassification_run WHERE run_status IN ('REQUESTED','RUNNING') AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at < NOW(3) OR lease_holder = #{holder}) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_cluster_reclassification_run SET run_status='RUNNING', lease_holder=#{holder}, lease_expires_at=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 2 MINUTE), started_at=COALESCE(started_at,NOW(3)), updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND run_status IN ('REQUESTED','RUNNING')
UPDATE t_cluster_reclassification_run SET lease_expires_at=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 2 MINUTE), updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND run_status='RUNNING' AND lease_holder=#{holder}
UPDATE t_cluster_reclassification_run SET run_status='ROLLING_BACK',lease_holder=#{holder}, lease_expires_at=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 2 MINUTE),error_detail=NULL,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE t_cluster_reclassification_run SET run_status='RUNNING',error_detail=NULL, lease_holder=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,completed_at=NULL,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND run_status='FAILED'

UPDATE t_cluster_reclassification_run SET run_status='RUNNING',error_detail=NULL, lease_holder=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,completed_at=NULL,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND run_status IN ('FAILED','COMPLETED')
UPDATE t_cluster_reclassification_run SET processed_count=#{counts.processed}, linked_existing_count=#{counts.linkedExisting},new_cluster_count=#{counts.newClusters},updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id}
